audience: small sales teams who track contacts, deals and online orders in Revamp CRM

useCases.title: See open deals by stage and value
useCases.text: The AI lists deals filtered by status, pipeline, owner or expected closing date, grouped by stage as a pipeline board. It adds up the value.

useCases.title: Find a contact with their deals and orders
useCases.text: The AI searches contacts by keyword or email, then reads their tags, stage, custom fields, deals and e-commerce order summary.

useCases.title: Check synced e-commerce orders
useCases.text: The AI counts the orders synced for a store and opens one order with totals, shipping status, line items and customer.

useCases.title: Add or update a contact
useCases.text: The AI creates a person or organization, with tags and a contact stage, or changes fields of an existing contact. Search first to avoid a duplicate.

useCases.title: Create a deal and add a note
useCases.text: The AI creates a deal for a contact and adds an internal note to a contact or a deal. Nothing is sent to the contact.

useCases.title: Mark a deal won or lost
useCases.text: The AI marks a deal as won, or as lost with a reason. It checks the deal first.
